_comment: Illustrative PDI 'site' reference. site_id -> ship-to state/city. Circle K site IDs are 270-prefixed (or 274 for some acquired CST sites). The last four digits alone are NOT unique across acquisitions, so a 4-digit-only match must be kicked out (see fueldata.site_state). NOT production data.

3900672.note: IT project number (Tempe Depot) - NOT a real ship-to site; must be manually assessed, do not tax at Tempe rate
